content:
**BLUF:** Russian forces launched 453 drones (plus some missiles) overnight into 13 September, with Ukrainian air defences neutralising 409; impacts recorded at 13 sites with multiple civilian casualties reported across regions including Odesa, Kharkiv and western Ukraine. Ukrainian forces struck Russian oil refineries in Tatarstan and Krasnodar Krai, plus drone launch/relay infrastructure. Taiwan’s daily MND report for the 12–13 September period recorded five PLA aircraft (three crossing the median line) and seven naval/official vessels. Houthi territorial gains near Bab el-Mandeb and the resulting shipping disruption remain active but largely unchanged from prior reporting. All other standing theatres returned no new verifiable developments inside the window.[[1]](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4163638-ukrainian-air-defenses-down-409-drones-used-by-russia-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html)[[2]](https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/13/russia-launches-more-than-450-drones-in-overnight-attacks-while-ukraine-strikes-oil-refine)[[3]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/news/6438814)

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrinform, RBC-Ukraine, Euronews and Al Arabiya (13 Sep, reporting period ending ~08:00–11:00 UTC) reported Russia launched 453 strike UAVs (Shahed-type including jet-powered, Gerbera, decoys and S8000 Banderol) from multiple Russian and occupied sites overnight into 13 September; Ukrainian forces neutralised 409, with hits at 13 locations and debris at seven more.[[1]](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4163638-ukrainian-air-defenses-down-409-drones-used-by-russia-to-attack-ukraine-overnight.html)[[4]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/western-ukraine-under-attack-fires-casualties-1789286841.html)

[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainian General Staff and Defence Intelligence (13 Sep) stated Ukrainian forces struck a drone launch/storage site in occupied Donetsk, relay stations and radar in Kherson/Crimea/Bryansk areas, plus the Taneco refinery in Nizhnekamsk (Tatarstan) and Slavyansk-ECO refinery in Krasnodar Krai, causing fires; Russian authorities reported two civilian deaths and 12 injuries in Nizhnekamsk.[[5]](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4163721-defense-forces-strike-russian-strike-drone-launch-site.html)[[2]](https://www.euronews.com/2026/09/13/russia-launches-more-than-450-drones-in-overnight-attacks-while-ukraine-strikes-oil-refine)

[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Regional Ukrainian officials (13 Sep) reported civilian casualties from the Russian strikes, including deaths and injuries in Odesa, Kharkiv, Zhytomyr, Kryvyi Rih and other areas, with residential and industrial damage.[[4]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/western-ukraine-under-attack-fires-casualties-1789286841.html)[[6]](https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/09/13/russian-attacks-kill-10-injure-dozens-in-ukraine-russia-says-it-hits-ships-plants)

### MIDDLE EAST
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential beyond continuation of prior Houthi territorial and shipping effects.

### INDO-PACIFIC
[OSINT - CONFIRMED] Taiwan News / MND (13 Sep, 11:37 local reporting period 06:00 Sat–Sun) tracked five Chinese military aircraft (three crossing the median line into southwestern and eastern ADIZ), seven naval vessels and two official ships; Taiwan responded with aircraft, ships and missile systems.[[3]](https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/news/6438814)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential beyond continuation of prior Bab el-Mandeb traffic reduction.

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

**Assessment (Europe/Russia-Ukraine):** The mutual deep strikes on energy infrastructure mark a continued escalation in the winter-preparation phase of the campaign; Ukraine’s refinery hits demonstrate reach into Russia’s rear while Russian drone volume remains high but interception rates also high, suggesting sustained pressure on Ukrainian air defence stocks without decisive breakthrough. Position of neither side materially shifted in the window, but the pattern increases risk of further reciprocal targeting of civilian-adjacent energy sites.

**Assessment (Indo-PACIFIC):** The daily PLA activity level remains within recent norms with modest median-line crossings; no surge detected, but the consistent presence continues to normalise gray-zone pressure on Taiwan’s ADIZ and test response times.

**Assessment (other theatres):** No material change to baseline posture or risk in quiet theatres.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**
- Additional Ukrainian refinery or logistics strikes inside Russia → likely Russian retaliation on Ukrainian energy/urban targets within 24–48 hours → first visible in Ukrainian regional governor statements or Air Force reports.
- Houthi expansion of embargo or attacks on non-Saudi vessels through Bab el-Mandeb → insurance spikes and further Suez rerouting → first in Lloyd’s List or Kpler shipping data.
- PLA aircraft/naval surge east of Taiwan beyond baseline (e.g., >15–20 aircraft or major naval concentration) → testing of blockade or escalation → first in Taiwan MND daily report.
- Belarus large-scale exercises or explicit mobilization orders near Ukrainian border → heightened NATO air policing alerts → first in Belarus state media or Ukrainian reporting.

**COLLECTION GAPS**
- Independent confirmation of exact damage, casualties and attribution for Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and any unreported Russian industrial hits.
- Full scope of Houthi control over Perim/Mayun Island and immediate effects on specific vessel transits or Saudi/coalition responses.
- Verification of any unreported incidents or posture changes in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas, strategic/space, cyber).
